## Scope

Describe exact requested behavior, frozen base/head, and files changed.

## Two-pass self-review

### Pass 1 — implementation

What was reproduced, changed, and tested?

### Pass 2 — adversarial reinspection

What did you try to break? Include regressions, mobile/keyboard/reduced motion, visual captures, failures, timeouts, and asset integrity.

SELF-REVIEW: FIX_REQUIRED
QA EVIDENCE: Add links to test outputs, browser captures, and the exact candidate SHA.
OPEN ISSUES: List blockers and all unverified checks explicitly.
OWNER ACCEPTANCE: PENDING

Do not mark PASS until both passes are complete. Do not merge or deploy without separate approval.
